description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain placement filters, including registration, ordering, and execution of custom placement filters, as well as several grain classes with placement filter attributes and strategies.

classes.name: GrainPlacementFilterTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for grain placement filter registration, ordering, and execution, including setup and various test cases.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture for setting up an in-process Orleans test cluster with placement filters.

classes.name: TestFilteredGrain
classes.description: A grain class with a placement filter attribute for testing filter registration and execution.

classes.name: TestPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: Custom placement filter strategy class with an order parameter.

classes.name: TestPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Implementation of IPlacementFilterDirector that triggers a semaphore when filtering.

classes.name: OrderAPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: Placement filter strategy with order parameter for ordering filters.

classes.name: OrderAPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Director that adds 'A' to the scratchpad during filtering.

classes.name: OrderBPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: Placement filter strategy with order parameter for ordering filters.

classes.name: OrderBPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Director that adds 'B' to the scratchpad during filtering.

classes.name: TestAB12FilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain with placement filters ordered as A=1, B=2.

classes.name: TestAB21FilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain with placement filters ordered as A=2, B=1.

classes.name: TestBA12FilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain with placement filters ordered as B=1, A=2.

classes.name: TestBA121FilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain with placement filters ordered as B=2, A=1.

classes.name: TestDuplicateOrderFilteredGrain
classes.description: Grain with duplicate placement filter orders to test error handling.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster asynchronously.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the test cluster with placement filters configured.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_GrainWithoutFilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Test to verify that a grain without a filter can be called successfully.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_FilterIsTriggered
methods.description: Test to verify that the placement filter director is triggered during grain placement.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderAB12
methods.description: Test to verify the order of filters applied to a grain of type ITestAB12FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderAB21
methods.description: Test to verify the order of filters applied to a grain of type ITestAB21FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderBA12
methods.description: Test to verify the order of filters applied to a grain of type ITestBA12FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderBA21
methods.description: Test to verify the order of filters applied to a grain of type ITestBA21FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_DuplicateOrder
methods.description: Test to verify that duplicate filter orders throw an exception.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Method in grains to simulate activity.
